added: **18th November 2026**
New Endpoint
**Publish default-account leverage tiers, position notional caps and margin-mode availability through a dedicated public leverage endpoint.**
Endpoints: `GET /leverage`.

GET /leverage accepts an optional ticker filter and publishes only the configured default margin group's schedule. Each symbol includes risk\_limits\_available and margin\_mode. When available, max\_leverage, max\_position\_notional, max\_position\_notional\_at\_max\_leverage, position\_limit\_currency, risk\_limits\_scope and leverage\_tiers describe exact leverage-dependent limits. Position notionals are precise decimal strings in quote-currency units and include same-side open-order exposure. Unavailable or invalid margin data omits numeric risk fields. Custom groups and account overrides remain private. GET /refdata and its legacy default\_max\_leverage behavior are unchanged.

**Affiliates can retrieve their own challenge standings for website display.**
Endpoints: `GET /affiliate-challenges/owned`, `GET /affiliate-challenges/{challenge_id}/owner-leaderboard`.
